title: Cloud Security Engineer & M365 Security Architect: Zero Trust to SOC Automation
description: A project-based course that bridges the gap between intermediate M365 administration (MD-102/MS-102) and senior security architecture (SC-500). You'll design Zero Trust identity perimeters with Entra ID, unify endpoint security with Intune and Defender for Endpoint, govern data and AI with Microsoft Purview, run a cloud SIEM/SOAR with Microsoft Sentinel and KQL, and automate it all with PowerShell, the Microsoft Graph API, and Logic Apps. You finish by building the three portfolio-grade projects hiring managers look for.
audience: M365 administrators, helpdesk/endpoint engineers, and cloud/IT professionals who want to move into a Cloud Security Engineer or M365 Security Architect role and need hands-on, portfolio-building experience aligned to real enterprise job descriptions and the SC-500 exam.

moduleTitles.1: Zero Trust Identity & Entra ID Governance
moduleTitles.3: Data Security & AI Governance with Microsoft Purview
moduleTitles.4: Cloud SIEM & SOAR Operations with Microsoft Sentinel
moduleTitles.5: Security Automation with PowerShell, Graph API & Logic Apps

targetRole: Cloud Security Engineer / M365 Security Architect
